nodes.name: Dependabot configuration
nodes.summary: Weekly version updates for Rust crates and GitHub Actions workflows, targeting the develop branch. Limits to 5 open PRs. Ignores oxiguitar-* dependencies since they come from OxiGuitar's git tags and Dependabot cannot resolve cross-tag version mismatches.

nodes.name: PR template
nodes.summary: GitHub pull request template requiring: description of changes with issue link, testing instructions, and a checklist (tests, docs/CHANGELOG/ROADMAP, CREDITS, no corpus files, no network use, DCO sign-off).

nodes.name: Design document
nodes.summary: Original design specification from issue #294: plugin architecture (per-track settings, Track tab Slint section, Perform interface 1.12), how it plays (only fretted tracks, note offset calculation, bend/slide handling, dead notes/harmonics), realistic guitar model (stretching, stiffness formulas, four guitar presets with D'Addario strings, finger press parameter), True Temperament implementation (Thidell Formula 1 offsets), test coverage, and future work (Perfect Temperament, slide fret-following, custom setups).

nodes.name: mdBook configuration
nodes.summary: mdBook settings for the Temperament plugin manual: title, authors, English language, source directory src. Configures HTML output with GitHub repository URL, edit URL template, light/navy themes, no section labels, and search enabled.

nodes.name: APT install script
nodes.summary: Resilient apt package installation for CI: monitors download progress to detect stalled mirrors, rotates mirrors on failure (up to 5 tries), keeps downloaded packages in cache, stops only when downloads are stuck (not slow). Uses Python to reorder mirror priorities. Shared across all OxiGuitar repositories. Environment variables: APT_STALL_SECONDS (120), APT_TRIES (5).

nodes.name: DCO sign-off checker
nodes.summary: Checks Developer Certificate of Origin sign-off on all commits in a range (BASE..HEAD). Skips bot commits (Claude app via noreply@anthropic.com, Dependabot via noreply@github.com with Co-Authored-By). Verifies Signed-off-by trailer matches author email. Used in CI's dco job on pull requests.

nodes.name: Test runner
nodes.summary: Unified test runner for all OxiGuitar repositories (1393 lines). Builds and runs cargo test, tests plugins against the newest OxiGuitar release, validates the Features page. Features: progress bar, environment detection (host triple, OS, arch), corpus testing through oxiguitar-cli (detect, convert, info), plugin contract checking, plugin file building (tar archives), feature-to-test validation, structured summary output (summary.md, test-all.log, corpus-*.json). Python 3.8+ standard library only.

nodes.name: Intonation model
nodes.summary: Physical model of real guitar intonation errors: StringSpec (MIDI key, tension, core diameter, Young's modulus), Guitar (scale length, nut height, action range, finger press depth, string specs), Tuned (compensated string with saddle setback). Computes fret-to-fret pitch offset from equal temperament due to string stretching and stiffness. Uses Varieschi & Gower (2010) and Anderson & Beausoleil (2024) formulas. Binary search for saddle compensation. FRETS constant caps at 24.

nodes.name: Plugin library entry point
nodes.summary: Root module declaring all public submodules (intonation, perform, section, settings, strings, true_temperament). Defines SECTION constant for the Track tab section ID. TemperamentPlugin struct holding a section::Section, implementing Plugin (start creates the section) and Performer (delegates to perform::perform). Exports the plugin via oxiguitar_plugin::export_plugin!. Includes a test validating manifest.json against the plugin type.

nodes.name: Performance engine
nodes.summary: Core performance function: takes a Perform track and returns Vec<PlayedNote> with pitch offsets applied. Handles three modes: Off (no change), Realistic (cents offset from intonation model), Formula1 (Thidell Formula 1 table lookup). Key logic: skips non-fretted tracks, dead notes, and open strings in realistic mode. Harmonics take open string offset. Bends/slides keep their curve shape with the starting fret's offset added. Prepares Tuned setups per staff once, then maps each note.

nodes.name: UI section handler
nodes.summary: Track tab UI section implementation for the Temperament settings. properties() builds the UI property list (modes, mode, about text, realistic flag, guitars, guitar). change() handles mode-chosen and guitar-chosen callbacks, updating Track settings. Section struct holds a Host and Mutex<Map<String, Json>> for current settings. Implements Ui trait with shown() (pushes properties to the Slint view) and callback() (processes user input, updates track settings via host). Includes a compile-time test validating the Slint file has matching properties and callbacks.

nodes.name: Settings persistence
nodes.summary: Track temperament settings storage: Mode enum (Off, Realistic, Formula1) with key strings and display names in Mode::ALL array. Track struct holding mode and guitar Kind. from_map/from_text parse JSON settings (graceful fallback to defaults for unknown/invalid input). write() serializes settings into a Map. Mode::key() and Mode::from_key() handle string-to-enum conversion.

nodes.name: Guitar string definitions
nodes.summary: Four guitar presets: NYLON (650mm, D'Addario EJ45), STEEL (25.4in, EJ16), ELECTRIC (25.5in, EXL110), BASS (34in, EXL170). Each defines scale, nut height, action range, press depth, and StringSpec array. Kind enum (Auto, Nylon, Steel, Electric, Bass) with of_program() mapping General MIDI programs to guitar kinds, guitar() returning the appropriate Guitar reference. Constants for unit conversions (LBF, INCH) and material properties (STEEL_E, NYLON_E).

nodes.name: True Temperament model
nodes.summary: Thidell Formula 1 temperament implementation: FORMULA_1 array of 12 note offsets (C +2 through B −1 cents), FORMULA_1_OPEN array of 6 standard-tuning open string offsets. formula_1(key) looks up the note's offset by MIDI key modulo 12. formula_1_open(key) returns the published open string tuning for standard strings, falling back to the note offset for other tunings or bass strings.

nodes.name: Contract test suite
nodes.summary: Integration tests that build the plugin as a .oxp file and test it through OxiGuitar's real plugin host. the_plugin_file_keeps_the_contract() validates the built .oxp against the plugin contract checker. the_host_plays_a_track_at_its_temperament() creates test tracks and verifies: Off mode changes nothing, Formula 1 applies correct offsets, Realistic mode sharpens first fret, non-fretted tracks are untouched.

nodes.name: Test suite configuration
nodes.summary: Test suite metadata declaring the repository name (mateusrdp/oxiguitar-temperament) and plugin configuration (name: temperament, package: oxiguitar-temperament-plugin, library: oxiguitar_temperament_plugin). Used by test-all.py to identify plugins for contract testing.

nodes.name: Temperament UI component
nodes.summary: Slint UI definition for the Temperament section in the Track tab. TemperamentSection component with in properties (modes list, mode index, about text, realistic flag, guitars list, guitar index) and callbacks (mode-chosen, guitar-chosen). Layout: Tuning label with mode ComboBox, about text description, conditional Guitar ComboBox shown only when realistic mode is active. Two-way binding between ComboBox index and property.
